title: 星尘简史
author: 狂热AI
summary: 一句话造出 138 亿年的宇宙。从一个光点出发，经过暴胀、夸克汤、第一缕光、黑洞与星系，16 万颗星尘一镜到底，再凝聚成地球、恐龙、青铜鼎、宇航员和星际飞船。
summaryEn: A 13.8-billion-year universe, one sentence at a time. From a single point of light, 160,000 particles of stardust travel through inflation, the quark soup, first light, black holes and galaxies in one continuous shot, then gather into Earth, a T. rex, a bronze ding, an astronaut and a starship.

facts.value: 约 3 分钟，25 个镜头

facts.label: 交付形式

facts.valueEn: One HTML file that runs offline

sections.title: 看什么
body: 影片按「起源、结构、太阳系、生命、文明、未来」六幕推进，从奇点和暴胀一路走到詹姆斯·韦伯望远镜和星际飞船。
右上角实时显示宇宙年龄与背景温度，右侧的时间尺可以点击跳到任意年代。空格暂停，拖动转视角，滚轮调远近。
bodyEn: The film moves through six acts: origins, structure, the solar system, life, civilization and the future, from the singularity and inflation to the James Webb Space Telescope and a starship.

The top-right corner shows the age and background temperature of the universe as it plays, and the timeline on the right jumps to any era. Space pauses, dragging turns the view and the scroll wheel zooms.

sections.title: 怎么做的
body: 片中 14 件造物各由 Aholo Lux3D 的 G1-Turbo 模型从一句中文描述生成 3D 模型，星尘再从模型表面取样，凝聚成它的形状。画面用 Three.js（r187）渲染，声音由 Web Audio 合成的提示音和一段背景配乐组成。
这里展示的是作者分享的单文件版：14 个模型、模型清单和配乐都以 base64 内嵌在一个 HTML 里，页面自己拦截请求、充当服务器，下载后双击就能离线打开。原版的「造物」面板可以写一句话实时生成新模型，需要作者的本地服务和 Aholo API key；单文件版里只能重看片中的 14 件造物。
bodyEn: Each of the 14 objects in the film was generated as a 3D model by Aholo Lux3D's G1-Turbo from a single Chinese sentence; the stardust then samples the model's surface and gathers into its shape. Rendering uses Three.js (r187), and the sound is Web Audio chimes over a music track.

This is the single-file edition the author shared: the 14 models, their manifest and the music are embedded as base64 in one HTML file, which intercepts its own requests and acts as its own server, so it opens offline. In the original, the Forge panel generates a new model from a sentence in real time through the author's local server and an Aholo API key; the single-file edition can only replay the 14 objects from the film.

sections.title: 关于这份收录
body: 作品与署名归作者狂热AI所有，片中右下角保留作者署名。本站托管的是作者在社群中分享的单文件版，内容未做改动，在与 lovstudio.ai 隔离的沙箱里运行，不连接任何网络。
bodyEn: The work and its credit belong to its author, 狂热AI, whose signature stays in the lower-right corner of the film. This site hosts the unmodified single-file edition the author shared with the community. It runs in a sandbox isolated from lovstudio.ai and makes no network requests.
